Hosted trial observed metrics (representative):
- Duration: 2 weeks of traffic from staging + small beta cohort.
- Average QPS (all endpoints): ~12 req/s (avg) with spikes to 52 req/s during load tests.
- Average concurrency (in-flight requests): 6 typical, peaks 28.
- Token mix: 68% short prompts (avg 70 tokens), 22% mid-length (avg 450 tokens), 10% long context (avg 1,600 tokens) used for multi-doc summarization.
- Embeddings usage: 18% of calls, mostly small-batch (up to 256 vectors) for semantic search.
- Latency targets: p95 <= 350ms for short prompts; p95 <= 1.2s for mid; tolerates up to 3s for long-context ops.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high — product KPIs depend on predictable per-token cost; procurement requires committed discount at ~6-12 month ARR thresholds.

Dedicated sizing ask / initial recommendation (SE notes):
- Expected baseline steady-state: 15 QPS (mix weighted to text gen + embeddings).
- Target peak planning: design for sustained 60 QPS for 10m windows (headroom for 95th percentile bursts).
- Concurrency target: reserve for 40 concurrent gen requests to keep latency SLAs.
- Token throughput estimate (monthly): ~600M tokens/month (based on projected 150k users x 50 tokens/session avg and embeddings usage).
- Hardware guidance: 3x H100-class nodes with autoscaling + 1 dedicated embeddings node (multi-GPU) OR 5x A100-80GB depending on quantization and model choice.
- Model strategy: prefer an open Llama-family v2-13B quantized for cost-sensitive routes; fallback to a higher-quality 34B variant for long-context summarization.
- Routing policy: latency-first for support-agent endpoints (hosted -> local Dedicated primary), cost-first for low-priority batch summarization -> queued lower-cost nodes.

- Deliver a formal BOM with per-node cost, expected sustained QPS, and estimated token burn within 3 business days.
- 60m sizing review with Arjun & Lila to walk through assumptions (proposed dates 2026-03-08 or 2026-03-09).
- Procurement to review committed tiers; requested example contract language around burst capacity and overage charges.
- Security to exchange SAML metadata and confirm KMS integration details.
